blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified: the attr keeps the drawn item between canApply and apply (`randItem`), the draw sits in canApply after three gate clauses, and apply moves the item and edits the shared loot list, so splitting it would re-implement the class. The won-battle test has no library atom (request R-B06-19: an atom 'I won the battle' reading the victory flag, and a gate/residual split of canApply, which is a foundation decision). Users (1 attr, no closure): Pickup (53, attr 0; the ability is unsuppressable). The class is asked for every Pokemon allowed in battle, so each Pickup holder draws separately in party order and the loot list shrinks as items are taken.
